hits.title: RoboStore Launches U.S. Robotics Manufacturing and Integration Company Named Robo Inc.
hits.snippet: After a year in stealth, foreign-made robot distributor RoboStore has launched a U.S.-based robotics manufacturing and systems-integration company called Robo Inc. According to Robo Inc., the New York-based company plans to open a 66,000-square-foot facility on Long Island that is expected to be fully operational by the first quarter of 2027. The company said the site will support engineering, software, integration, production, testing, service and customer support. The public launch comes just two weeks after the U.S. banned new advanced foreign-made robotics. The launch comes shortly after new U.S. restrictions on advanced foreign-made robots, while Robo Inc. plans to emphasize U.S.-based assembly, localized data infrastructure, security reviews and application-specific integration. However, successful robotics adoption requires more than advanced hardware. hits.snippet: Roboinc.com RoboStore, North America's most active distributor of humanoid and quadruped robots, today publicly launched Robo Inc., a US-based manufacturing and systems integration company designed to fill the compliance gap left by the Federal Communications Commission's July 28 decision to block new Chinese-made advanced robots from the American market. The company says it will open a 66,000-square-foot (roughly 6,130 square meters) facility on Long Island, New York, expected to be operational by January 2027 — a concrete deadline and a named address in a sector that has historically offered neither. [...] ### What Comes Next The 66,000-square-foot (6,130 square meters) Long Island facility is planned to begin producing US-localized robotic solutions in January 2027.
